name: release-overnight
description: Prepare an alchemy release unattended overnight, in series — after one go-ahead, nuke the testing account, then walk every provider's live suite one at a time (Cloudflare → core unit → core integration → small providers → Fly → GCP → AWS), fixing each until its whole suite passes in one run AND the account census is clean, then run `pnpm test:examples`, and finish with one alchemy PR plus at most one distilled PR and one floci PR, all linked, that merge into a release passing every test.
